title: Chat model fine-tune (LoRA)
summary: Teach a language model your own style and knowledge from example chats. Use your Mnx as the base model to keep training it. A GPU is strongly recommended.

dataset.hint: JSONL, one example per line: {"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "…"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "…"}]}, or {"prompt": …, "completion": …}, or {"text": …}.

params.name: base_model
params.label: Base model (Hugging Face id or folder)
params.help: Put your own Mnx repo here to keep training it, e.g. your-name/mnx-3b.

params.name: merge
params.label: Merge LoRA into the model
params.help: Gives one standalone model folder (bigger, simpler to run).
